scripts.brain: cd ../.. && uv run --with watchfiles watchfiles --sigint-timeout 2 'python marketing/local.py' marketing/backend marketing/frontend/src/data
scripts.brain:types: cd ../.. && uv run voqalize types marketing/backend/brain.py -o marketing/frontend/src/scripts/actions.gen.ts
scripts.brain:test: cd ../.. && uv run pytest -q tests/test_marketing_brain.py tests/test_marketing_screen.py
scripts.build:release: SOURCEMAPS=1 astro check && SOURCEMAPS=1 astro build && posthog-cli sourcemap inject --directory dist --release-name voqalize-marketing-website && posthog-cli sourcemap upload --directory dist --release-name voqalize-marketing-website --delete-after
